BIOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

8. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Chemicals of Life? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Chemicals of Life.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Chemicals of Life.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Chemicals of Life.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Chemicals of Life.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Biology? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Biology.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Biology.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Biology.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Biology.

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transport? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Transport.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transport.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transport.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transport.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Gaseous Exchange and Respiration? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Gaseous Exchange and Respiration.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Gaseous Exchange and Respiration.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Gaseous Exchange and Respiration.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Gaseous Exchange and Respiration.

16. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Cell Structure and Specialisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Plants 2.1 Nutrition 2.2 Transpo and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Chemicals of Life and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Nutrition 2.2 Transport 2.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Phy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Nutrition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
